name: 黃榮堂
objective:
本課程主要在講述醫學工程基本觀念，內容包括解剖學及生理學、醫學工程簡介、生物力學、復建工程及輔具科技、生醫材料、組織工程、生醫電子系統、生醫感測系統、生醫訊號處理、生醫影像處理、生醫超音波、生醫光學及雷射。
This course mainly introduces the basic concepts of Geriatric Medical Engineering, including anatomy and physiology, geriatrics, biomechanics, rehabilitation engineering and assistive device technology, biomaterials, tissue engineering, biomedical electronics, biomedical sensing systems, biomedical signal processing, biomedical image processing, biomedical ultrasound, biomedical optics and laser.
schedule:
WEEK 1     Biomedical Engineering: A Historical Perspective
WEEK 2-3   Anatomy and Physiology
WEEK 4-5   Biomechanics
WEEK 6-7   Biochemical Reactions and Enzyme Kinetic
WEEK 8     Bioinstrumentation
WEEK 9     MIDERM EXAM
WEEK 10-11. 	Biomedical Sensors
WEEK 12. 	Biosignal Processing
WEEK 13. 	Bioelectric Phenomena
WEEK 14-. 	Radiation Imaging
WEEK 15-16.	Medical Imaging
WEEK 17. 	Biomedical Optics and Lasers
WEEK 18     FINAL EXAM
scorePolicy:
期中考  35%

期末考  50%

出席與平時作業 15%
materials:
INTRODUCTION TO BIOMEDICAL ENGINEERING  JOHN D. ENDERLE and  JOSEPH D. BRONZINO  3rd Edition

投影片  教學
